article.headline: Bennett scores 30 as Dayton takes down Florida Atlantic 86-79 in NIT
article.description: — Javon Bennett scored 30 points and made eight 3-pointers to lead Dayton over Florida Atlantic 86-79 on Wednesday in the NIT.
article.linkText: Bennett scores 30 as Dayton takes down Florida Atlantic 86-79 in NIT

article.story: BOCA RATON, Fla. -- — Javon Bennett scored 30 points and made eight 3-pointers to lead Dayton over Florida Atlantic 86-79 on Wednesday in the NIT. Dayton (23-10) advances to play Chattanooga in the second round. Bennett shot 10 for 16 (8 for 12 from 3-point range) and 2 of 3 from the free-throw line for the Flyers (23-10). Nate Santos shot 5 for 9 (2 for 5 from 3-point range) and 3 of 4 from the free-throw line to add 15 points. Enoch Cheeks had 12 points and shot 4 for 10 (1 for 5 from 3-point range) and 3 of 6 from the free-throw line. The Owls (18-16) were led in scoring by Kaleb Glenn, who finished with 18 points. Tre Carroll added 17 points for Florida Atlantic. Baba also put up 16 points, seven rebounds, four assists and two steals. Dayton led 44-38 at halftime, with Cheeks racking up nine points. Bennett scored 24 points in the second half. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
